title: Kill the Mutants
prompt: Implement the validator `issues` exactly per the contract. The graded tests are a mutation suite: boundary mutants (`<` vs `<=`, missing edge chars) must fail — your implementation has to be exact at every boundary to kill them all.

tests.name: valid names pass
tests.hint: Length exactly 3 and exactly 20 are both valid — the boundary is inclusive on both ends.

tests.name: every rule fires, in order
tests.hint: Check rules in the documented priority: length, then first-char, then char-set, then double-underscore.

tests.name: boundary mutants die
tests.hint: Off-by-one mutants (`<` vs `<=`) survive only if the exact boundary values are untested — test both 3 and 20 exactly.
